Indian tech worker laid off by Oracle after 12 years in US

An Indian national working for Oracle in the US was laid off after 12 years with the company. The employee received an email about the termination at 6 AM. His wife stated that he had worked through holidays like Holi and Diwali during his tenure. The layoff is part of broader job cuts at Oracle, with reports suggesting thousands of jobs are at risk.
